# Security policy

Found a vulnerability in https://pokeor.github.io/order/ ? Please report it privately through
**Security -> Report a vulnerability** on this repository (GitHub private advisories). Do not open a public issue
and do not test against other users' data. We aim to answer within 7 days.

In scope: the site, the Supabase API rules (RLS), the storage bucket, the realtime channel.
Out of scope: denial of service by volume, social engineering, third-party services.
